purpose: Speak these lines out loud. If you would not say it today, it does not belong here.

chapters.title: The Wrong Order
chapters.scene: South Gate Coffee, Chengdu, Monday 8:47 a.m.

story.text: Monday. Lin is late. The coffee shop is packed.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Hi. One oat latte to go, please.

story.speaker: Barista
story.text: Name for the order?

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Lin. L-I-N.

story.speaker: Barista
story.text: Got it.
She checks her phone. Standup is in ten minutes.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Oh no.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: Long line, right?

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Yeah. I usually come earlier.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: Same. First week here. I keep getting the time wrong.

story.speaker: Barista
story.text: Oat latte for Lin?

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Thanks.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: Wait. Sorry. I think that's mine.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: This one?

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: Yeah. I ordered an oat latte too. Name's Alex.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Oh. My bad. Here you go.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: No worries. Easy mix-up.

story.speaker: Barista
story.text: And an oat latte for Alex. Two of them.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Then this one is mine.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: Perfect.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Are you heading to the office too?

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: South Gate? Third floor? Yeah. I start today.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: You're the new designer. I'm Lin. Product.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: Nice to meet you, Lin.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Nice to meet you too. We can walk together, if you want.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: That'd be great. I still get lost.
They step outside. A scooter goes by.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: How do you like Chengdu so far?

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: I like it. It's warm. And the food is a lot.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: In a good way?

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: In a very good way. I just don't know what to order.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: I can show you a place at lunch. If you're free.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: I'm free. I'd like that.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Cool. We should move. Standup is at nine.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: After you.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: If you need anything today, just ask.

story.speaker: Alex
story.text: I will. Thanks for not stealing my coffee.

story.speaker: Lin
story.text: Hey. I only borrowed it.

phrases.en: One oat latte to go, please.
Are you heading to the office too?
We can walk together, if you want.
phrases.zh: 要是你愿意，我们一起走。

phrases.en: That'd be great. I still get lost.
I can show you a place at lunch.
phrases.zh: 中午我可以带你去一个地方。

phrases.en: If you need anything today, just ask.
phrases.zh: 今天需要什么，直接问我就行。

role_play: You are Lin. You just picked up the wrong coffee.
1. Say it is not yours and give it back.
2. Check if they are going to the same office.
4. Invite them to lunch, but keep it light.
Then switch. You are Alex, first week in town.

notes.zh: 外带。for here 才是堂食。
熟人/轻松场合认错。正式场合用 Sorry about that.
比 That's mine 客气，适合对陌生人。

notes.en: if you want / if you're free
notes.zh: 把邀请变软，对方好拒绝。
答应邀请的短口块，比 Yes, I would 自然。
收尾用，表示你可以来找我。
